p.i: summi Doctores judicant, juventutem esse linguis & artibus breviter instituendam, & et Christianam doctrinam una cum lacte nutricis, ut R.D.D. David Chytraus, Praeceptor meus ante triennium Rostochy plurimum observandus, in Proœmio sua Catechefis loquitur, esse instillandam.

Et profecto ante, quàm summum illud hoc seculo Philosophorum lumen, Petrus Ra-mus, artes juxta leges Aristotelicas reforma-vit: vix Grammaticam & dialecticam ante vigesimum annum Studiosi absolvere in Scholis potuerunt. Nunc vero, laus Deo Opt. Max. puer quinque annorum, singulis diebus fideliter institutus, ante vigesimum annum liberales artes, Dei auxilio absolve-re potest.

main_text.p: Vestræ autem Celf. Illustr. PRINCEPS, hæc meas primitias tum propter eximiam V. Celf. erga liberalium artium propagatores pietatem, tum propter singularem erga τὰς ἀρετὰς ὀρεῳ ἀνδρὰς[?] clementiam dedicare volui, obnixè humiliterq; rogans, ut V. C. hoc dedicationis meæ consilium in bonam partem interpretetur: id quod si intellexero, V C.

page.notes: The Greek phrase "τὰς ἀρετὰς ὀρεῳ ἀνδρὰς" is a doubtful reading of a faint line; the middle words are uncertain and marked [?]. The printed "Rostochy" and the hyphenated line breaks are copied as shown. No marginal notes, page number or catchword are visible. The text is set in italic type, and "PRINCEPS" is in small capitals.
